content.comment_body: Hello, I am unable to connect my [product_name]. I updated the CP210X driver, but it remains on COM4 and I still cannot connect.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. This is an English-speaking forum, so please write your future posts in English. Thank you.
Which [product_name] model are you using specifically?
You can download the driver for Windows 11 from [url]. It's the CP210x Universal Windows Driver V11.0.0 released on 11/17/2021.
Are there any other COM interfaces available for selection?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble connecting their [product_name] hardware to their PC after updating the CP210X driver. The device remains assigned to COM4, but cannot establish a connection, indicating a possible compatibility or configuration issue with the hardware setup on Windows 11.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates a straightforward connection process after installing the latest driver, expecting the operating system to detect and communicate with the [product_name] hardware without issues.
